reason: Although FallbackLocaleList#[] (config/initializers/i18n.rb:12-24) replaces I18n::Locale::Fallbacks with [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en], Discourse only supports underscore-separated regional locales like pt_BR (config/locales/server.pt_BR.yml:7, config/application.rb:82, lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:13-17). Standard I18n::Locale::Fallbacks in i18n 0.7.0 (Gemfile.lock:126) splits locale tags only on hyphens via I18n::Locale::Tag::Simple, so it never provided base-language ancestor fallbacks for any supported Discourse regional locale, and hyphenated locales are rejected by available_locales enforcement.
